scope: Input, confirmation, focus, completion, accessibility, instruction submission and subscription image integration audit

requested_distribution.reason: No supported redistributable personal-subscription credential was established. No account session was exported or bundled. The available subscription build still requires an eligible ChatGPT sign-in on the destination computer.

fixes: Optional heuristic confirmations default off in backend, Electron and Settings
Status card is non-focusable and uses showInactive to preserve target focus
Status card hides if it overlaps an upcoming click; positioned above Windows notification area
Checked Win32 SendInput down/up pairs surface blocked clicks instead of swallowing input failures
Unicode typing including supplementary characters; Stop checked between characters and after pointer movement
UIA actual value/text patterns replace invalid property lookup and field-label verification
UIA search timeout corrected from 1000 seconds to 1 second
Unverified type plus done in one response requires another observation
Rejected confirmation stops the task; non-boolean protocol approvals are ignored
Instruction bar receives backend task states and keeps instructions when submission fails
64-bit native cursor handle declarations corrected; cursor is hidden only when overlay is enabled

tests.javascript_runtime_audit: passed: production status window functions and instruction renderer exercised with mocked Electron/DOM
tests.live_subscription_image_schema: passed using gpt-6-luna and Codex CLI 0.159.2
tests.live_screenshot_only_vision: passed: randomized target location and fresh random-code OCR, no accessibility tree or answer in prompt
tests.live_native_process_cancellation: passed; child process exited and temporary screenshot directory removed

live_gated_app.approval: Native click on real Electron Approve button

tests.independent_verification: Fixture recorded actual input/click events; native screenshot and accessibility readback also confirmed click count and Luna café Ω 🙂
tests.live_stop_button: Stopped the harmless pending confirmation through the real status card
tests.package_source_match: Frontend and changed backend files match source; no auth/config/seed files in app.asar

limitations: Live runs reused the owner's existing sign-in on this PC; they do not prove the requested sign-in-free independent distribution.
Fresh VM installation, recipient authentication and arbitrary third-party workflows were not tested.
Screenshot vision was tested; no separate natural-photo classification benchmark was run.

Early test harness attempts were corrected for UTF-8 file reading, replayed task IDs and an interim-summary expectation. A Windows notification obstructed the first approval attempt; the status card was relocated before the successful complete run.
A concurrent build initially hit a Windows executable lock while live Codex inference was running; the final build succeeded after inference finished.
Pre-existing changes were preserved. git diff --check still reports the pre-existing trailing blank line in electron/build/provision-macro.nsh.
The existing installed older app and its configuration were not replaced; test apps ran in an isolated configuration directory and were closed.
